name: TDC ADMET VDss_Lombardo
description: Predict the volume of distribution at steady state of a drug in humans (L/kg) from its molecular structure, given as a SMILES string (endpoint VDss_Lombardo of the Therapeutics Data Commons ADMET benchmark group). The measured compounds are split by molecular scaffold into a training, a validation and a test part. The test part is fixed; the candidate is run five times (seeds 1 to 5), each time with a different division of the other compounds into training and validation. It receives the training and validation compounds with their values and the test compounds without, and returns one prediction per test compound. Each of the five runs is a separate process that receives only these arguments: it cannot read the evaluator's files, start other processes or open network connections, and it has 700 seconds. The score is the Spearman rank correlation between the predictions and the measured values of the test compounds, averaged over the five runs; higher is better, and only the order of the predictions counts.
contract: fit_predict(train_smiles, train_y, valid_smiles, valid_y, test_smiles, info) -> sequence of finite numbers, one per test molecule in the given order: the predicted value. train_smiles, valid_smiles and test_smiles are lists of SMILES strings, train_y and valid_y lists of numbers; info has name, metric, kind ('regression' or 'binary') and seed. Score: mean over the seeds 1 to 5 of the Spearman rank correlation between predictions and measured values on the test part, maximized.
notes: Downloaded by PyTDC at first use into data/admet
Predicts the human volume of distribution at steady state of 1,130 drugs from their SMILES strings, scored by Spearman rank correlation.
Leaders are large tuned ensembles or foundation-model fine-tunes.
Needs PyTDC and rdkit: not in .venv-tasks, so the evaluator restarts itself under tools/venv-admet (created by the README's setup steps).

Every scoring call of the candidate runs in the main suite's sandbox (a child process with an audit hook, 700 s and 6 GB for one call): it keeps a search from coming across the test labels and is not a security boundary against a candidate written to attack the evaluator.
One evaluation of the starting program took 190 s in the run of 2026-11-11, more than the arena's default limit of 120 s: raise AR_EVAL_TIMEOUT for this task.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Predict the human steady-state volume of distribution (L/kg) of a drug from its structure.
